scope: Independent file/code/mathematical re-audit; no claim of formal proof of all repository history

findings.finding: D3 same-center support was truncated to the intersection of two balls
findings.resolution: Retain D3 failure, never use its full matrix as an oracle. New repair computes TP/PT only.

findings.finding: D5A eta failure did not identify pure longitudinal ETF underresolution
findings.resolution: The analytic exp(iq eta) oracle is resolved at n=96. Withdraw the stronger causal assertion; retain eta-slice failure.

findings.finding: Compact C0 FEM derivatives and support edges are not smooth global-quadrature amplitudes
findings.resolution: Use interface-aligned integration. First derivative has no boundary delta when u(L)=0; weak kinetic remains valid.

findings.finding: D4C radial orders 6/8/10 are insufficient for diffuse oscillatory cross integrals even after geometric alignment
findings.resolution: Same-spec p16/20/24 refinement closes the declared z=-12 TP screen without changing basis/Hamiltonian.

findings.finding: Global-to-cross-block normalization changes were not reflected consistently in narrative interpretation
findings.resolution: Report absolute difference, denominator, block identity, units and relative difference together; do not compare percentages across changed norms.

findings.finding: One-axis last-pair passage is not joint convergence: D5A S passes eta slice but disagrees with improved integral
findings.resolution: Preserve old screen outcome; do not promote it into an actual integration-error bound.

findings.finding: R2 tests do not cover the full diffuse FEM cross-coupling case that later failed
findings.resolution: Keep 84-test historical pass, add actual same-spec TP evidence rather than repeatedly executing unrelated tests.

findings.finding: Seven post-R2 Python scripts are outside the original strict source manifest
findings.resolution: Use the new isolated delivery validator; version manifest scope during integration rather than silently bypass it.

findings.finding: Original B3 uses controlled fixed-CAP symmetric propagation and Gram-selected-span output
findings.resolution: Do not falsely diagnose base TDLRunner legacy raw projection/CAP as the actual B3 production path.

findings.finding: Historical GPU CUDA-path pass evidence exists; latest CPU-only skips do not erase it
findings.resolution: No full GPU rerun solely because new CPU FEM quadrature failed. No current hardware health claim.

findings.finding: Original 3% spatial capture pair and new static FEM coupling failure are distinct validation targets
findings.resolution: New TP success does not resolve original capture gap, preparation, CAP, finite time or all-bound.

findings.finding: R3A declared stop-on-first-failure was not executed that way by the supplied heredoc
findings.resolution: Keep first failure and post-first-failure diagnostics separately. Do not erase useful later geometry rows.

findings.finding: D1 automatically set capture allowed after only two static geometry screens
findings.resolution: New repair and all reports always keep capture_execution_allowed=false. Full time-dependent contract required.

findings.finding: Some D2 declared screens and independent-rule differences were computed but not used in final classification
findings.resolution: Do not treat D2 COMPLETE as numerical admission; review classifier contract with implementation on integration.

findings.finding: Longitudinal phase, derivative kinks and near-zero cross cancellations were conflated into a single-cause story
findings.resolution: Sufficient controlled intervention demonstrated; percentage attribution among individual effects is not established.

findings.finding: Duplicated/stale role and status documents disagree in scope
findings.resolution: Use explicit source/authority path and external receipts. Never rewrite old validation as new completion.

findings.evidence_status: static finding not exercised on real GPU
findings.finding: Explicit cupy request can fall through to numpy when import succeeds but device count is zero
findings.resolution: Fix via separate fail-closed runtime patch and mock/device tests only if preparing GPU execution. Not evidence of historical silent CPU execution.

findings.finding: High-n/continuum completeness and basis placement remain physical approximation questions
findings.resolution: Integrate a bounded physical pilot and compare common typed outputs; do not create indefinite new administrative gates.

findings.finding: Large original GPU wavefunction payloads are not in this source export
findings.resolution: Use existing original endpoint/backups when needed. Source restore is not full state restore.

findings.finding: Two order16 attempts interrupted by current container time cap before a complete numerical result
findings.resolution: Preserve both as execution-harness interruptions. Third fresh output completed; no scientific failure was overwritten.
